description.short: A local full-stack web app that turns AI-sourced job leads into a focused pipeline for reviewing roles, managing applications, and tracking outreach.

long.label: Project and Experience
long.text: Job Search Facilitator turns job discovery into one review, application, outreach, and tracking workflow. Users can review ranked roles, set priorities, manage application files, find contacts, draft messages, and track follow-ups.

long.label: System Design
long.text: A Vue and Pinia client uses an Express, Prisma, and PostgreSQL API for durable workflow data. A host-side bridge streams structured Codex tasks, while isolated agents discover jobs and judge candidates through validated artifacts.

long.label: Controlled Agent Workflows
long.text: The bridge turns Codex activity into visible, recoverable application state, including reasoning, failures, and browser permission requests. Read-only execution and schema-validated artifacts keep job imports and outreach results inside explicit access and data boundaries.

description.short: Tally Tracker is a cross-platform app for personal and shared counters on iOS, Android, and web, with real-time collaboration and offline synchronization.

long.label: Project and Experience
long.text: Tally Tracker is a cross-platform counter app for personal and shared tracking. Users can track counters, invite participants through deep links, and continue working through disconnects.

long.label: System Design
long.text: Actions update local state first and enter a durable command queue. The API, database, and real-time layer coordinate replay and synchronization across reconnects, restarts, and concurrent devices.

long.label: Decisions and Tradeoffs
long.text: Offline support shaped authentication, idempotency, state reconciliation, and web/native token delivery. I accepted added synchronization complexity so the app could stay responsive and recover cleanly after connection loss.

description.short: A reaction-time training app with timed drills, animated feedback, user accounts, and performance history, backed by a secure Express/PostgreSQL API.

long.label: Project and Experience
long.text: Reaction is a training app built around configurable reaction-time drills. Players can adjust settings for each drill, receive animated feedback, and review results across recent sessions and their full profile history.

long.label: System Design
long.text: Vue and Pinia manage the game flow while GSAP coordinates feedback and transitions between game states. An Express and PostgreSQL API stores accounts, results, statistics, and the settings used for each attempt.

long.label: Interaction Design
long.text: GSAP timelines coordinate countdowns, target feedback, score changes, settings, and end screens without mixing animation into gameplay logic. Flip transitions reorganize profile filters and history columns while preserving continuity across responsive layouts.

description.short: A real-time tic-tac-toe lobby with JWT-authenticated Socket.IO sessions, server-side move validation, rematches, forfeits, and disconnect recovery.

long.label: Project and Experience
long.text: GameLobby turns tic-tac-toe into a complete multiplayer flow with authenticated lobbies, live matches, rematches, forfeits, and recovery from temporary disconnects.

long.label: System Design
long.text: Socket.IO connects each player to a server-authoritative game session that validates moves, turns, and match outcomes. User-to-socket tracking supports reconnects and multiple tabs, while Prisma and PostgreSQL persist users and games.

long.label: Verified Multiplayer Flow
long.text: Socket-level tests connect real clients through authentication, game creation, joining, wins, draws, forfeits, rematches, and disconnects. They exercise the same event handlers that coordinate live matches, not only isolated board rules.
